# Vernon Bainton

**Headline:** Chief Medical Officer | Medico-Strategic Lead | Transformative Technologist | Board member / NED | Advisor  | Mentor
**Current role:** Chief Medical Officer
**Seniority:** C-Level, Medical
**Location:** Greater London, England, United Kingdom
**Experience:** 26 years 7 months
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/vernon-bainton-9071a817 · 6,255 followers
**Description:** Specialising in influencing behavioural change to improve health outcomes. Whilst studying medicine I gained a neuropharmacology degree, before qualifying and training as hospital physician and anaesthetist for 5 years after which I joined the pharmaceutical industry within Janssen Cilag’s Mental Health Business Unit and BMS’s Oncology Business Unit in field medical affairs and commercial roles. Transitioning to healthcare communications and digital innovation, I've now over twelve years’ of experience including a number of industry firsts. My eclectic communications experience spans advertising, medical education, clinical trials, payer and corporate comms including evidence-based patient empowerment initiatives and clinical service redesign, health technology assessment and most recently health policy. I've contributed to the successful delivery of programmes for UK, European and global clients and implemented them as far afield as US, Canada, Australia and BRIC (Brazil, Russia, India and China) countries. Now Chief Medical Officer and Board member of the Havas Lynx Group, I lead our Scientific function and services together with providing medico-strategic and compliance stewardship to more effectively solve communication problems. I've worked on nearly the A to Z of therapeutic areas including: • Allergology • Biologics and biosimilars • Cardiovascular disease • Dermatology • Endocrinology and metabolic disorders • Gastroenterology • Genomics • Haematology • Heath policy • HEOR, PRO and PRE • HTA and value frameworks • Immunology • Infectious diseases • Fertility and IVF • Medical aesthetics and devices • Mental health • Neurology • Oncology • Pain management • Renal medicine • Respiratory medicine • Rheumatology • Virology • Womens health

## Experience
- **Chief Medical Officer** at Havas Lynx (Jan 2017 to present)
- **Medical Director** at Havas Lynx (Nov 2014 to Jan 2017)
- **Client Partner** at DigitasLBi (Feb 2014 to Oct 2014)
- **VP, Medical Director** at Health4Brands Europe (part of the HAVAS global network) (Feb 2012 to Jan 2014)
- **Medical Director** at Sudler & Hennessey (Jun 2009 to Feb 2012)
- **Group Account Director** at Sudler & Henessey (Transart) (Jan 2009 to Jun 2009)

## Education
- The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), Exec MSc Health Economics Policy and Management with Distinction
- University of Birmingham, Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery - MBChB Medicine
- University of Birmingham, Bachelor of Medical Sciences (BMedSci) Pharmacology
